# Test paths that Backend CI runs a second time with CLICKHOUSE_HOGQL_USE_NEW_EVENTS_SCHEMA=true,
# against the native-JSON events table. The leg runs wherever the legacy tests run. A run of the
# full legacy matrix (the merge queue, the hourly master run, a PR the selector cannot narrow)
# takes every path. A narrowed PR run takes the paths its test selection reaches, plus the paths
# of the products whose tests it runs. A change to products alone takes those products' paths.
# The test-new-events-schema label doubles the backend suites. Listed paths those suites
# exclude still run here so the label does not reduce native-schema coverage.
#
# Only tests that read event properties can behave differently between the two events tables,
# so the list holds those directories plus the modules that own a *.new_events_schema.ambr
# snapshot. A module outside the list runs against the legacy table only, and its JSON snapshot
# goes stale. When you add a directory of tests that read event properties, add it here.
#
# One path per line, directory or file, relative to the repository root. A file under a listed
# directory needs no line of its own. Every path must hold at least one test module.
#
# products/experiments stays out until HogQL reads $feature/<key> from the $feature_flags map.
# Its tests fail against the native-JSON table until then.
# posthog/dags/tests/test_data_deletion_requests.py stays out because it calls the JSONDropKeys
# UDF, which the ClickHouse config of the Django test job does not define.

# HogQL, its query runners, and the ClickHouse layer below them
posthog/hogql

posthog/session_recordings/queries
